answer_1.quote: the goal is to generate an abstractive summary faithfully capturing the information from the post-both image and text-and comments. ... we propose cluster-based multi-stage summarization (CMS), a novel method to summarize multimodal discussions.

answer_2.quote: Following the standard metric for summarization evaluation, we use the ROUGE and BertScore. ... We also compute the CLIPScore between the image and the first sentence of the generated summaries.

answer_4.quote: We additionally perform human evaluation studies via MTurk to compare the summaries generated from CMS-T5-ImgCap (ours) versus the baseline T5-ImgCap model. ... we use three metrics to measure the summary quality: fluency, faithfulness, and overall quality.
answer_4.guideline: Annotators on MTurk were asked to rate each generated summary on fluency, faithfulness, and overall quality.
